profile_text.body:
tl;dv is an AI-powered meeting recorder and notetaker founded in 2021. The name stands for "Too Long, Didn't View." The product automatically records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings, generating timestamped notes, follow-up email drafts, and next-step tasks based on call content. It supports transcription and translation across more than 30 languages and dialects, and integrates with CRMs, ticketing systems, knowledge management platforms, and what the company describes as over 5,000 other tools. The company positions tl;dv as suitable for sales, customer success, and internal meetings.

Beyond note-taking, the company describes tl;dv as a sales coaching platform, offering features such as playbook adherence tracking, objection handling analysis, and AI-selected clip libraries for onboarding new hires. Sales managers can use it to monitor representative performance in real time. The platform also generates aggregated reports from multiple meetings to surface trends and insights. The company offers a free tier with no time limits, and contrasts this with what it characterizes as a $5,000 or more upfront investment required by Gong.

On data handling, the company states that recordings and transcripts belong to users and will not be used to train AI. The platform is described as GDPR-compliant and SOC 2-certified, with data stored in ISO 27001-certified data centers using AES-256 encryption. tl;dv partners with Anthropic for generative AI capabilities, anonymizing metadata and processing meetings in randomized chunks. The held facts confirm the product is EU-hosted with consent management features, and the company's profile was verified as of August 2026.
